newsitem.title: CANADA: AT Plastics sees lower Q3 net income.
newsitem.headline: AT Plastics sees lower Q3 net income.

text.p: AT Plastics Inc said on Wednesday that it expects third quarter net income to be down about C$1 million from the previous second quarter.
AT Plastics said in a statement the profit decline was due to a slowdown in polymers and packaging product sales, timing problems in passing on higher resin costs and an unexpected plant shutdown.
The company reported a C$4.4 million profit in the second quarter of 1996.
At Plastics also announced plans to build a new specialty compounds facility in the United States.
